strings.en: Commander, I've given everyone their orders.
It's not much time, but everyone will get some rest.
Thank you, Captain.
Kyosuke... about you and Excellen...
would you tell us the details?
Sir.
I'm interested too.
Is that all right?
Banjo, Hibiki... I'd like you to get some proper rest, though?
No, more than any fatigue, it's this mysterious enemy, the Einst...
I find them fascinating.
Me too. ...Raideen and the Star of La Mu...
and Excellen and the Einst... There's so much I want to know.
It can't be helped. Kyosuke, is that all right?
Yes.
...Her and me...
The reason Excellen started hearing their voices
was probably... that accident, I think.
An accident?
...I know of that accident. It's fairly well known in parts of the Federation.
I've never heard of it.
Well known, but only among the top brass.
I only heard about it in passing myself.
What sort of accident was it?
Mind if I tell it, Kyosuke?
...Yes, please.
The One Year War was nearly over. A shuttle from Luna II to Jaburo
suddenly exploded in flames right after reentry... and crashed.
Exploded in flames?
Right after passing through the atmosphere... In the stratosphere?
That's right.
...That shuttle was carrying dozens of officer cadets.
And in the wreckage of the fallen shuttle... survivors were found.
Don't tell me... that was...?
Me, and her.
It was far too unnatural.
...Not only did the two survive, but as for Excellen,
far from burns... she reportedly hadn't a scratch on her body or clothes.
And you, Kyosuke?
I was sent to the hospital.
...But my injuries weren't all that serious.
That's crazy...
Kyosuke, don't you remember anything?
...No. When the blast filled my vision... I shielded Excellen...
After that, I don't remember a thing until we were rescued...
And you think... the Einst were involved?
I don't know.
But it was far too unnatural to call a miraculous survival.
That's precisely why the top brass assigned the two to separate units
and kept them under watch.
That they were excellent pilots played a part too.
Still, there's no explaining it. Perhaps it truly was a miracle.
To hear that from you, Captain, who believes in miracles least of all...
That's harsh, Amuro.
...There's just one thing I can't explain.
Hm?
If my memory's right...
when I shielded Excellen... she...
When the explosion happened?
...had taken a fatal wound from the debris.
So there's no way she came out unhurt...
Someone... did something to her?
Omoikane, how are you feeling?
Good.
...But you're still you now thanks to everyone. Don't forget that.
Pardon the intrusion.
Akatsuki...?
My, my, how careless. Just one operator on the bridge.
Hoshino, would you call the bridge crew together for me?
Sure, but... what are you scheming?
An experiment. A simple one.
Erina. ...An experiment?
That's right, an experiment.
...At this rate, the Nadesico will have to keep fighting
alongside Londo Bell forever, won't it?
That's what I figured.
Well, as a pilot I couldn't ask for more, but with the surface settled down,
I figured now's our chance.
Everything's ready outside, Akatsuki. The CC has been scattered.
Now we just leave it to Dr. Inez.
CC... Tulip Crystals...! Don't tell me...
What's up? What'd you want to talk about...?
Inez?
There you are, you two. Well then... shall we begin?
Begin...? Begin what?
There's no time right now. Forgive me.
Time?
Akito, Captain... I'll explain later.
First, would you think about Mars for me?
Mars...? Why, all of a sudden...
Think, both of you... This is an experiment.
We might be able to take Mars back
from the Meganoids and the Za Boom Army...
O-Okay, I get it. I'll give it a shot...
Remember, Akito... Captain... Remember Mars.
The happy days in Utopia Colony...
I-I don't really get it, but...
Mars... Utopia Colony... Before the Meganoids... playing with Akito...
Mars... Ai...
The three of them... vanished!? Akito! Captain! Inez!!
Called up out of nowhere, just to be shown this...!
Hey, what was that light just now...
A Boson Jump.
How!? Those three!?
Tenkawa and the other two... are still gone.
Hoshino, the monitor, please! This is a historic moment.
Nadesico, forming Boson Jump field.
Surely... you don't mean to jump with the whole Nadesico!?
Wh-What? What the hell's going on!?
......I'm counting on you, Tenkawa...
The Nadesico... has vanished?
What the heck's going on...!
Don't tell me... that something-or-other Jump thing?
There's no doubt. There's residual boson reaction...
Good heavens. How on earth did they do it?
Before, when Tenkawa and I were sent flying to the Moon...
we used a material called "Tulip Crystal" to form a boson field.
...It was probably the same thing.
Don't you know... where they went?
...I have a pretty good guess, but...
Master Banjo, we've learned where the Nadesico jumped to.
That was quick, Garrison. But if it was that quick, then it must be...
Yes. This is footage from the spy satellite we sent to Mars.
I see. So the Nadesico's there?
Yes. And... we've also spotted what appears to be the Gaizok.
Whaaat!?
Looks like they're... up to something.
Tch. While the cat's away, huh? And the Nadesico went flying right into it.
But... can we catch up?
Yeah, how long does it take to get from here to Mars?
If it's Mars... using the Elshank's worm drive,
we can reach it in a short time.
We're coming too!
If it's the Gaizok we're up against, we can't just leave it!
Yeah, and while we're at it, we'll kick the Za Boom guys off Mars too...!
Don't forget the Meganoids. I'll go too.
We may be stretched thin. I'll go with them as well.
...I think some of the mobile suit units
that were to return to space should go to Mars instead?
Agreed. ...Nanbu and Rain will go to Bright.
Captain, I'm counting on you for Mars.
Understood.
(Space, huh... Excellen,
if something happened in space... why come to the surface...?)
All right.
Ground team, Captain Bright in space, the Elshank and Nadesico to Mars...
Splitting our forces can't be helped, but the operation begins now...!
